entries.name: Haseoka Clan
entries.content:
The Haseoka Clan is an all-female family of swordswomen. The clan is renowned throughout Japan for their power and swordsmanship, and their lineage spans back thousands of years.

However, despite the clan being composed of purely women, once every couple of centuries, a male child is born to the Haseoka. In the event of this, the male is worshipped and raised to become a powerful swordsman in his own right, as well as to marry and breed with a female clan member to continue the bloodline (typically one from the main house).

Women in the clan often venture out in search of men to conceive a child with, and return to the Land of Dosūn after “having their fill” (usually meaning when they are done having children). Women from the main branch of the family, however, like Serana, and her mother, Ume, in the past, invite men into the main house, where they are allowed to stay only as long as the matriarchs or main house clan members need them. After the men have outlived their usefulness, they are expelled from the Land of Dosūn completely, while being paid handsomely for their contributions.

If a male is born to the matriarch of the clan, he will be brought up as the successor to the clan, until the day when he produces a female child with one of the members of the clan to continue the matriarchy. If a male is born outside of the matriarchy or the main house in general, the male will then be brought into and raised in the main house. However, that male will not be eligible to become the next clan head, instead simply being responsible for breeding with a main branch family member and producing a female heir.

The Haseoka clan is quite large, with each and every woman being unique and powerful in their own right. In the current era, the Haseoka consists of over ten thousand members.

The clan has several rivals across Japan, such as the Hanafuda Clan, the Rokaida Clan, the Hayase Family, etc. These rival clans constantly scheme and compete with one another, and with the Haseoka Clan, to steal and gain even greater wealth and power. However, despite the animosity between the clans, they also meet semi-annually to discuss Japan’s affairs, as they all hold high ranking positions in Japan’s political hierarchy.

entries.name: Land of Dosūn
entries.content:
The Land of Dosũn is a vast land in Japan, where the Haseoka Clan compound resides, which they also control completely. All resources within the Land of Dosūn are under the control of the Haseoka Clan, which has lent considerably to their vast wealth.

The land itself includes a vast forest, mountains, and rivers. The Land of Dosūn is also home to many animals and flora, some of which exclusively reside and/or grow in that region. One such species residing in Dosūn, specifically in the mountain regions, are the ten-tailed foxes and two-headed wolves.

One major resource that is unique and native only to Dosūn is Sulurite, a material that resembles meteorites. The material is near-invincible, and also grants enhanced speed and strength to anyone who can utilize it. 

This is why, in  all of the Haseoka Clan’s swords, weapons and armor, Sulurite makes up the entirety of the blades, making their slashes much stronger than the average weapon. Due to its extreme durability, their blades are also almost indestructible, especially against regular blades and weapons.

However, this is a secret known only to the Haseoka themselves. The other clans are aware of the existence of Sulurite, but none know of what it is capable of.

No outsiders are allowed in the Land of Dosūn, and many members of the Haseoka maintain contracts with the various beasts around the land to secure and protect Dosūn from outsiders and anyone attempting to intrude upon their lands.

entries.name: The Saido
entries.content:
The Saido is an elite military unit within the Haseoka Clan. Historically, it is headed by the clan matriarch’s eldest daughter, who, typically, is the Saido’s strongest member, as well. The Saido itself is known across Japan for being one of the strongest military units overall.

In the current generation, the Saido is led by Ruka Haseoka, the firstborn daughter and child of Serana Haseoka, the clan’s current head and matriarch.

The Saido is composed of about eight hundred members, the reason for this being that each member, due in part to carrying weapons and armor made of Sulurite, possesses the power of a hundred men.

entries.name: Hanafuda Clan
entries.content:
The Hanafuda Clan are a powerful clan of Demon Slayers and Exorcists, having specialized in these trades for many, many years. They have passed down several powerful and secret techniques through the ages, keeping their strength on par with that of their rival clans, like the Haseoka and Rokaida Clans. The clan also specializes in using swords in combat, believing that their blades are necessary to claim the undead souls of Demons and the supernatural. As for the Exorcists, they specialize in powerful spirit-based attacks and incantations.

The Hanafuda Clan resides in the mountains, having set their compound there due to the high volume of Demons and spirits around that area and forests. They are led by their clan head, Ushio Hanafuda, an eighty-seven year old man who, despite his age, is still quite powerful and feared across Japan, and even by some of his rivals. His heir apparent is his grandson, Naseo Hanafuda, stated to be a one-of-a-kind prodigy of his generation.

The Hanafuda Clan has been at odds with the Haseoka Clan for centuries, with it having been said that at one time, a past head of the Haseoka had killed a head of the Hanafuda, leading to even more resentmeant from the latter.
